title: Snap your plate.
intro: NUSI recognises the dish and estimates its nutrition from the photo. These are close approximations, not exact measurements — adjust anything that looks off.

capture.analyzingTitle: NUSI is looking at your plate

hints.heading: Help it estimate better
hints.portionHelp: Telling it the serving size noticeably changes the estimate.
hints.scaleRef: A spoon, hand or card is in the photo
hints.scaleRefHelp: Gives it a real-world object to measure the plate against.

provenance.note: These numbers are an AI estimate, not a database lookup. The same plate can come out slightly differently. Your nutritionist sees them marked as estimates.
provenance.notFood: No food found in this photo. Try again with the meal clearly in frame.

alternatives.heading: Not quite right?
alternatives.help: Pick what it actually is and NUSI will redo the breakdown.

log.logNote: Saved to your history and sent to your nutritionist, clearly marked as a photo estimate.

tips.heading: Tips for a good photo
tips.topDown: Shoot top-down so every item is visible.
tips.light: Good, even light - avoid harsh shadows.
tips.onePlate: One plate per photo gives the cleanest read.
tips.fillFrame: Fill the frame; keep the whole meal in view.
tips.scaleObject: Leave a spoon or your hand in frame for scale.

how.heading: How the numbers are made
how.step1: NUSI recognises the dish and the foods on the plate.
how.step2: It estimates each portion from visual cues, then the nutrition for that portion.
how.step3: Telling it the serving size, or correcting the dish, makes the estimate noticeably better.
how.estimateFooter: Estimates, not measurements. Adjust any portion that looks wrong before logging.

toast.analyzeError: Could not analyze the photo. Try again.
toast.pickImage: Please pick an image - JPG, PNG, or HEIC.
toast.tooLarge: Image too large - pick one under 8 MB.
